Q: Best way to store current date (day month and year) A:

Determining a "best" of something requires criteria for comparison and evaluation. You mention two things/operations you want to do. Is that your only criteria? Which one is more important?

You mention "store a date" but not any resolution. Hence using a number of seconds could be overkill compared to simply the number of days since X.

Q: What size lookup table would be considered too large for a shared and static library? A:

What the point? On modern OSs executables are paged in on demand - same as mmap files. The should be no difference in performance. But inconvenience of downloading and installing a huge binary is the same. And the cost of paging them in is significant too.

may be the Chapter 5 quoted above meant generating lookup table in RAM rather than loading it?

Q: How to loop query results in a CodeIgniter controller A:

$users must be defined. Your model's data is assigned to $data["users"].

Q: WCF client exception: Unrecognized message version A:

I had this issue as well. I know this is an older post, but in my case I modified the app.config file in my C# .NET app that calls this web service. I think it was adding

<security mode="Transport" />

to the basicHttpBinding element that solved it. I also extended the timeouts and maxBufferPoolSize.

Microsoft has documentation that describes this, in case this helps someone else.
